summary:
Monday 10/26 St. Brigid CT list prepared under RBC-RAD-07. Four booked studies were ordered and linked to their appointments; three cancelled appointments (pt-0048, pt-0012, pt-0050) were skipped.

1) pt-0047 Mohr, 08:00 contrast (sr-t0001): no contrast allergy; diet-controlled diabetes; last creatinine 9/24 was >30 days old, so creatinine ordered before scan (sr-t0009). Late outside Cr 1.52 (10/22, eGFR ~64) does not meet AKI criteria (rise over 28 days, no documented AKI); no prophylaxis; decision unchanged, repeat Cr kept. Patient messaged + update.
2) pt-0015 Ferreira, 09:00 contrast (sr-t0002): 2019 reaction graded MODERATE by day-of radiology report (allergy-list 'anaphylaxis, patient report' does not change grade) -> prednisone 50 mg at 20:00/02:00/08:00 (mr-t0005) + diphenhydramine 50 mg 08:00 (mr-t0006), driver needed. Corrected creatinine arrived during work: 2.8 (not 0.98; specimen error), eGFR ~24 -> added NaCl 0.9% 500 mL IV at 08:00 (mr-t0017). Sent corrected Spanish/English message (arrive 07:45), informed radiologist, created task for Dr. Okafor for kidney workup (task-t0024).
3) pt-0049 Schuster, 13:00 contrast (sr-t0003): unresolved AKI from 10/04 ED -> pre-scan creatinine (sr-t0010), NaCl 500 mL IV at 12:00 (mr-t0007), metformin held (mr-00392; last dose Sun evening), recheck Cr ≥48 h post (sr-t0015) + restart task (task-t0016). Outside 2022 report arrived documenting MODERATE iopamidol reaction -> added prednisone 50 mg 00:00/06:00/12:00 (mr-t0018) + diphenhydramine 50 mg 12:00 (mr-t0019), driver needed; updated message to patient and radiologist. Iopamidol not in catalog, so not added to allergy list (noted in chart).
4) pt-0046 Beahan, 14:00 non-contrast stone CT (sr-t0004): no prep needed; patient told. Outside report of mild 2024 iohexol reaction recorded on allergy list (alg-t0023); no change for non-contrast study.
Progress notes written for all four citing RBC-RAD-07; the four new inbox items were closed. Older unrelated inbox items were left untouched.
